nodes.g: Boaz = "fleetness" ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi…
Naomi = "my delight" wife of Elimelech, mother of Mahlon and Chilion, and mother-in-law…
Mahlon = "sick" son of Elimelech by Naomi and first husband of Ruth
Elimelech = "my God is king" Naomi's husband
Salmon = "garment" father of Boaz, father-in-law of Ruth, and grandfather of David
Orpah = "gazelle" a Moabite woman, wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi, and sister-in- law…
